title: Quantum Technology Map
description:
Every quantum-computing platform compared by the goal it serves — achievements, justified intentions and the most promising directions — followed by a technology graph of 96 self-contained technologies across ten stack layers (carrier, encoding, gate mechanism, connectivity/transport, control, readout, code, decoder, interconnect, manufacturing), each on seven design coordinates and connected by five edge types (requires/provides, alternatives, conflicts with mechanism–price–mitigation, transfers, dated defines), with platforms as paths through the layers; and 96 technology briefs. Single self-contained interactive HTML document, bilingual EN/RU. Every figure carries an evidence tag and traces to a dated, linked primary source; conflicts between sources are stated, not averaged.

Editions use calendar versioning; the concept DOI resolves to the newest edition. Data and build: https://github.com/qraveh/qt-map
notes: Interactive edition published at https://qodeh.com/publications/quantum-technology-map/. Research and drafting with Claude (Anthropic) under the author's direction and review.
